title: Preserve exact predecessor capture custody across automatic named-root switches
outcome: An automatic switch between named roots preserves the exact old turn's closing scope and report when a successor opens or closes while the predecessor's capture is pending.
acceptance: A deterministic test pauses a predecessor before focus sampling and queues a same-binding successor's closing capture. Neither report is lost or relabeled.
Define which component owns the old binding until its durable capture or explicit terminal outcome when automatic switching is introduced.
